questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

72 - 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 24 = 30
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 72 - 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 24 = 30

(1) - and ÷

⇒ 72 - 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 24 = 30

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**72 ÷ 12**__ + 8 × 6 - 24 = 30

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 6 + __**8 × 6**__ - 24

⇒ 6 + 48 - 24

⇒ 54 - 24 = 30

⇒** '72 ÷ 12 + 8 × 6 - 24 = 30'**

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(2) - and +

⇒ 72 - 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 24 = 30

After changing the signs:

⇒ 72 + 12 - 8 × __**6 ÷ 24**__ = 30

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 72 + 12 - __**8 × 0.25**__

⇒ 72 + 12 - 2

⇒ 84 - 12 = 72

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) - and ×

⇒ 72 - 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 24 = 30

After changing the signs:

⇒ 72 × 12 + 8 - __**6 ÷ 24**__ = 30

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**72 ×**____** 12**__ + 8 - 0.25

⇒ 864 + 8 - 0.25

⇒ 872 - 0.25 = 871.75

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) × and ÷

⇒ 72 - 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 24 = 30

After changing the signs:

⇒ 72 - 12 + __**8 ÷ 6**__ × 24

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 72 - 12 + __**1.33 × 24**__

⇒ 72 - 12 + 32

⇒ 104 - 12 = 92

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**- and ÷**".

questions.question: The Governor of State possesses the pardoning power under which Article of the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Article 161.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The answer to the given question is option 2, i.e., Article 161.**
 
• The pardoning power is the power to grant a reprieve or pardon to a person convicted of a crime.
 
• This power is vested in the Governor of a State under **Article 161 of the Constitution of India.**
 
• The Governor can **grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment or suspend, remit, or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offense against any law relating to a matter to which the executive power of the State extends.**
 
• However, the Governor cannot pardon a** person who has been sentenced to death without consulting with the Council of Ministers of the State.**
 
• The pardoning power of the Governor is an important constitutional check on the judiciary and ensures that justice is tempered with mercy.
 
• Hence, the statement is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Article 163** of the Constitution deals with the **Council of Ministers, which aids and advises the Governor of a State.**
 
• **Article 55 **pertains to the election of the **President of India.**
 
• ** Article 145 **specifies the rules and procedures to be followed by the** Supreme Court of India.**

questions.question: A, B, and C can do a piece of work in 42, 56, and 63 days respectively. They started the work together but A left the work 10 days before the completion of the work while B left the work 12 days before the completion. Find the number of days (approximate) to complete the whole work.
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 42 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 56 days

Time taken by C to complete the work = 63 days

A left the work 10 days before completion

B left the work 12 days before completion

**The concept: **

LCM (Least Common Multiple) and work done concept

Find LCM of 42, 56, and 63 to find the total units of work.

Use work = efficiency × time to find the work done by each individual.

**Calculation:** 

LCM of 42, 56, 63 = 504 units

⇒ Daily work done by A = 504 / 42 = 12 units/day

⇒ Daily work done by B = 504 / 56 = 9 units/day

⇒ Daily work done by C = 504 / 63 = 8 units/day

Let's assume the work is completed in D days.

⇒ Total work done by A = 12 × (D - 10) (as A left 10 days before completion)

⇒ Total work done by B = 9 × (D - 12) (as B left 12 days before completion)

⇒ Total work done by C = 8 × D

Summing up work done by A, B, and C should be equal to total units of work (504).

⇒ 12(D - 10) + 9(D - 12) + 8D = 504

⇒ 12D - 120 + 9D - 108 + 8D = 504

⇒ (12 + 9 + 8)D = 504 + 120 + 108

⇒ 29D = 732

⇒ D = 732 / 29

⇒ D ≈ 25 days

**Therefore, the work will be completed in approximately 25 days.**
